title: Payments
intro: Students pay for courses straight to your UPI, then send the payment reference. Check it in your bank or UPI app, then approve to give them the course.
emptyPending: Nothing to check. New payments show up here.
exportHelp: A spreadsheet of payments reported between two dates: amount, UPI reference, student, course and what was decided. Amounts are plain numbers, so the sheet can add them up.
upiReady: Students see these details on a paid course's payment page.
upiNotReady: Add a UPI ID or a phone number so students can pay. Until then, paid courses can't be bought.
priceHint: Set a course's price on its Edit course page.
rejectReason: Why it can't be confirmed ({student} sees this)
endBeforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
offline: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
uploadFailed: The upload didn't work. Try again.
qrBadType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
qrTooBig: The QR image can be at most {mb} MB.
noQr: No QR code yet. Students can still pay to the UPI ID or number.
qrHint: The QR from your UPI or bank app (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB).
upiSaved: Saved. Students see these details when they pay for a course.
instructionsPlaceholder: For example: write your name and course in the payment note.
